classification.narrative: One-time manual Ubuntu VM import test (via VM Import/Export, vmimport-admin IAM user) on 2026-07-08: ImportImage -> RegisterImage (ami-0f7f7a0d1841cedca) -> RunInstances at 09:15:19Z created instance i-0e461d34f76b84b53, whose root volume (vol-0c0a7abcb61186356) was created 1 second later at 09:15:20.444Z from the AMI root snapshot snap-0e8998fbd84787b5f. The SAME root user terminated the instance at 09:29:39Z and deregistered the AMI with deleteAssociatedSnapshots=true at 09:30:17Z, all within one ~15-minute cleanup session. The root volume alone survived because the imported AMIs block device mapping had deleteOnTermination=false (an AWS VM-import default), which the launch request never overrode. It has sat unattached ever since (~85 days). Unrelated to the Gymini/fitness-assistant application in any way.
